title: job request
description: The first control frame (kind 'C') on a job channel, hub->bench. Flat: op, then one key per parameter value, plus size/sha256 for image ops and board when the hub has a board chosen (src/alb/remote/protocol.py:361-374; src/alb/remote/flash.py:840-842, 853). The bench ignores keys its table does not name (clients/windows-agent/alb_agent.py:1190-1194); the hub refuses them before sending (src/alb/remote/bench_ops.py:337-345). No path, no command line ever rides this frame.

size.description: Image ops only: exact image length in bytes. The bench refuses <= 0 (clients/windows-agent/alb_agent.py:3512-3522).

board.description: The board the hub has chosen; the bench uses it for the product identity check before a write.

additionalProperties.description: A parameter value keyed by ParamDesc.name: string (partition, enum, text), integer (int) or list of strings (argv).
